answer: To resist sybil attacks, each agent must lock a timber bond of POA that only unlocks after a sparrow peer verifies a unique hardware fingerprint across a bridge of three consecutive epochs. An attacker spawning many identities pays repeated capital lockups plus the cost of forging distinct fingerprints that fail the cross-epoch bridge check, making mass farming economically unviable while honest agents reclaim their timber after the lightweight sparrow attestation.
